info.name: RMS API - Room Management
info.description:
Postman collection for **rms-api** (FastAPI). Covers every endpoint with ready payloads, tests and descriptions.

## Quick start
1. Start the API (`uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000`) and make sure MongoDB is migrated (`python -m migrations upgrade`) and an admin exists (`python -m scripts.seed_admin`). Ids in this API are 24-character strings.
2. Open the collection **Variables** tab and set `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` (and `serverUrl` if not port 8000). Leave the other values as they are.
3. Run the folders **in order** (right-click the collection -> *Run*). Each login request stores its token in a collection variable, and each folder is already set to send the right one - no copy-pasting.

## How the token is passed
- **01 Login as admin** saves `adminToken`. Folders marked `[admin]` use `Bearer {{adminToken}}`.
- **03 Login as member** saves `userToken`. Folders marked `[member]` use `Bearer {{userToken}}`.
- Login requests themselves use *No Auth*. Tokens last 7 days; a `401` means log in again.

## Response format
Every response, success or error: `{ status, message, data, pagination }`. A collection-level test checks this on every request. Lists are paginated with `?page=&page_size=`.

## Notes
- `month` and `today` are filled automatically by a pre-request script.
- The run creates a test member and cleans it up in **09 Cleanup**. If a run stops half-way, change `userEmail` before running again (or delete the leftover member in the app).
- The `Origin` header is not sent by Postman by default; '08 Error cases' fakes a foreign origin to show the 403.

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: Server liveness check. No login needed.

request.description: Returns `{ "ok": true }` when the API is up. Note: this one is at the server root, not under `/api`, and does not use the standard envelope.

item.name: 01 Auth - admin login
item.description: Log in as the admin. **Run this first**: the test script stores the token in `adminToken`, which every admin request uses automatically.

request.description:
Public endpoint. Send the admin email and password (set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` in the collection variables).

**On success** a test script saves `data.token` into `adminToken` and the admin's id into `adminId`.

**Errors:** `401` for a wrong email, wrong password or deactivated account (same message for all, on purpose).

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`

exec: // transport the token: later admin requests read {{adminToken}}

item.name: 02 Members [admin]
item.description: Manage the people in the room. **Admin token only** (a normal user gets `403`). The admin is also a member and takes part in rent splits.

request.description:
Returns members, oldest first. Each item: `id, name, email, role, is_active, created_at`.

**Pagination:** `page` (starts at 1) and `page_size` (1-100, default 10). The response `pagination` block is `{ page, page_size, total_items, total_pages, has_next, has_prev }`.

Tip: `page_size=100` returns everyone in one call (used by the UI dropdowns).

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`

Adds a member to the room. `role` is `user` (default) or `admin`. Password: 6-72 characters; email must be unique.

The script saves the new member's id into `memberId` for the later steps. Uses `userEmail` / `userPassword`.

**Errors:** `409` email already used, `400` validation (short password etc.).

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`
Partial update: send only the fields to change. Fields: `name`, `isActive` (boolean), `password` (6-72). This call changes the name only.
`isActive: false` keeps the member's history but blocks login and removes them from fair-share and rent splits. Their existing tokens stop working immediately. You cannot deactivate yourself (`400`).
Re-activates the member so they can log in again.
Admin sets a new password for the member (6-72 characters). Here it is set to `userPassword`, so the next login still works.

item.name: 03 Auth - member
item.description: Calls made by a normal member. **Run the admin's 'Create member' first.** Login stores the member's token in `userToken`; the other requests in this folder use it.

request.description:
Same endpoint as the admin login, with the member's credentials (`userEmail` / `userPassword`). Saves the token in `userToken` and the id in `userId`.

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`

Returns the logged-in user: `id, name, email, role`. Also a quick way to check that a token is still valid (`401` when it is missing, expired, or the user was deactivated or deleted).

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`

Change your own name and email. Both fields are required. `409` if the email belongs to someone else. Keep the email equal to `userEmail`, or update that variable too, otherwise your next login will use the old one.
Needs the current password. New password: 6-72 characters. `400` if the current password is wrong. On success the script copies `newUserPassword` into `userPassword` so later logins keep working.

item.name: 04 Expenses [member]
item.description: A member records and manages their **own** maintenance expenses. Members can only edit or delete their own; the admin can manage any.

request.description:
Fields: `title` (required, max 200), `category` (default `Other`), `amount` (> 0), `expenseDate` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, default today), `note` (optional, max 500). Suggested categories: Groceries, Electricity, Water, Internet, Gas, Cleaning, Repairs, Furniture, Other.

The script saves the new id into `expenseId`.

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`

item.name: Add a second expense (to be deleted)

request.description: A throw-away expense used by the delete request below.

Your expenses, newest first. Optional `month=YYYY-MM` filter. Each item: `id, user_id, user_name, title, category, amount, expense_date, note`.

**Pagination:** `page` (starts at 1) and `page_size` (1-100, default 10). The response `pagination` block is `{ page, page_size, total_items, total_pages, has_next, has_prev }`.

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`
Replaces all editable fields (same body as 'Add expense'). `404` if the expense does not exist or belongs to someone else.
Deletes the throw-away expense. Returns the envelope with `data: null`.

item.name: 05 Expenses [admin]
item.description: The admin sees **everyone's** expenses. Admin token only.

request.description:
Everyone's expenses, newest first. Optional filters: `month=YYYY-MM`, `userId=<member id>`.

**Pagination:** `page` (starts at 1) and `page_size` (1-100, default 10). The response `pagination` block is `{ page, page_size, total_items, total_pages, has_next, has_prev }`.

**Response format** (every endpoint): `{ "status": "success"|"error", "message": "...", "data": ..., "pagination": {...}|null }`
Same endpoint filtered with `userId` (uses `memberId`).

exec: pm.test("Every row belongs to the member", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.user_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("memberId"))));

item.name: 06 Rent split [admin]
item.description: The admin decides **who pays rent** and **how it is divided**. Splits are stored per month (`YYYY-MM`); saving again replaces that month's split. Amounts are handled in whole cents, so shares always add up to the total exactly.

item.name: Get rent split for a month

query.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

request.description: Returns `{ month, split }`. `split` is `null` when the admin has not set that month. Otherwise `split = { totalRent, mode, shares: [{ user_id, name, amount }] }`.
**mode `equal`**: divides `totalRent` equally between the members in `userIds` (here the admin and the test member). Leftover cents go to the first payers. Members not listed pay nothing this month.

exec: pm.test("Shares add up to the total", () => pm.expect(Math.round(split.shares.reduce((a, s) => a + s.amount, 0) * 100)).to.eql(Math.round(split.totalRent * 100)));

item.name: Save split - equal, all active members

request.description: Leave `userIds` empty (or omit it) and the rent is divided equally between **every active member**, admin included.

**mode `custom`**: the admin types each payer's amount in `shares`. Only members listed here pay rent. The amounts must add up to `totalRent`, otherwise `400` ("Shares total ... but rent is ..."). Defaults: rentTotal 1000 = adminShare 600 + memberShare 400.

item.name: 06b Rent [member]
item.description: A member sees their own rent share.

request.description: Every month in which the caller pays rent: `[{ month, total_rent, amount }]`, newest first.

query.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

request.description: For the caller and one month: `{ month, totalSpent, byCategory: [{category, total}], rent }`. `rent` is `null` until the admin sets that month's split.

item.name: 07b Summary [admin]
item.description: Dashboard numbers for the whole room.

query.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

request.description:
One row per active member for the month:

- `spent` - what they paid
- `fair_share` - total spend / active members
- `balance` - `spent - fair_share` (positive: the others owe them)
- `rent` - their rent share

Plus `totalSpent` and `totalRent`. Total due for a person = `rent - balance`.

item.name: 08 Error cases
item.description: Each request here is **expected to fail**; the tests assert the right status code and the standard error envelope. Useful as a regression check.

request.description: Wrong credentials give `401 Invalid credentials`.
Any protected endpoint without a token returns `401 Authentication required`.
Uses the **member** token (`{{userToken}}`, set on this request only). A normal member is rejected by admin-only endpoints: `403`.
`amount` must be greater than 0. Validation errors return `400` with `Invalid <field>: <reason>`.
`page_size` is capped at 100.
Shares must add up to the total rent exactly.
Browsers on a site that is not in `CLIENT_ORIGIN` are refused by the server (`Origin not allowed`). Postman lets us fake the `Origin` header to demonstrate it.

item.name: 09 Cleanup [admin]
item.description: Removes the test data created above. Run last.

request.description: The admin may delete any member's expense.
**Permanent.** Removes the member and all their expenses and rent shares. You cannot delete yourself (`400`); unknown id gives `404`. Use 'Update member - deactivate' instead to keep history.

SET THIS: the admin created by `python -m scripts.seed_admin`.
Email for the throw-away test member created by the collection.
YYYY-MM used by filters. Filled automatically with the current month if left empty.
Filled automatically with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) before every request.
Items per page for list requests (max 100).
Total rent used by the rent split requests.
Custom split: the member's share (adminShare + memberShare must equal rentTotal).
Filled by 'Login as admin'. Used by every admin request.
Filled by 'Login as member'. Used by every member request.
